name: Source tax on a BVG annuity and lump sum paid abroad, from Zurich, with no treaty known
workings: Living under generic from 2026, whose country the module doesn't know, so no treaty refunds the source tax. The canton is the plan's last Swiss residence: Zurich, city of Zurich.
BVG annuity 30,000.00: federal 1% = 300.0000 (DBG Art. 96 para. 2); Zurich 6% cantonal and communal = 1,800.0000 (7% in all with the federal 1%).

BVG lump sum 250,000.00, taxed as a capital benefit. Federal: 1/5 of the tariff on 250,000 = 3,900.6880. Zurich: the tariff's rate on 1/20 (12,500.00) is below 2%, so 2%: simple tax 5,000.0000 x (95% + 119%) = 10,700.0000 (no church tax).
AHV pension 30,000.00: no source tax (a warning that its taxedIn should be residence).
